description: Get one public Product Hunt forum thread by forum and thread slug, including its body and a bounded page of replies.

parameters.name: forum
parameters.description: Forum slug from the Product Hunt thread URL, such as general or openai.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread slug from the Product Hunt thread URL.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of replies to return, from 1 to 50.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Return body blocks, reply products, page links, and full reply metadata when true.
